# T04 requests (do not edit shared / layout / pom / yml from this branch)

## T00 — PlaceholderController & nav
1. Remove `/appointments` and `/queue` from `PlaceholderController` module-root mappings so T04's controllers own those paths. Until then, Spring fails to start with ambiguous mappings if both are present.
2. Optional: add an ER nav link to `/er` for `ROLE_ER` / `ROLE_ADMIN` in `templates/layout/base.html` (key `nav.er`). T04 serves `/er` already; there is no placeholder for it.
3. Optional: allow `static/js/appointment-queue.js` (live queue SSE + 10s poll). File lives under `static/js/` because CSP is `script-src 'self'` (no inline).

## T01 — Red Alert assignee
V250 adds `red_alert.assigned_er_user_id`. When set, `JdbcAccessFacts.activeRedAlert` can require the current ER user id to match (narrower than “any ER”). Until T01 reads the column, any ER remains assigned to any active alert (current T01 behaviour).

## T03 — Directory slots
T04 uses a local `SlotCatalog` / `JpaSlotCatalog` over shared `slot` tables. When `DirectoryQueryService` is available as a shared port (or documented façade), prefer wiring that instead of reading directory tables directly.

## T05 — Encounter + vitals
T04 listens to `DomainEvents.VitalsClassified`. CRITICAL patient-level vitals auto-raise Red Alert and remove the patient from the OPD queue. Publish after commit with a real `encounterId` that has `appointment_id` set (created at check-in).

## T10 — Queue / schedule events
T10 noted missing `QueueCalled` / schedule-changed events. T04 audits `QUEUE_CALLED` and publishes an internal `QueueChanged` for SSE only (not in `DomainEvents`). If T10 needs a shared event, add it in T00 and T04 will publish.
